mapper.select: select ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_STATUS entrustStatus, ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.ASSET_TYPE1 assetType1, ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.ASSET_TYPE_10 assetType10, ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.ASSET_TYPE_11 finprodAbbr, ETR_ENTRUST.FINPROD_ID finprodMarketId, ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_AMT entrustAmt, ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.MATURE_YIELD matureYield, ETR_ENTRUST.CCY ccy, DATE_FORMAT(ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.VDATE ,'%Y-%m-%d') vdateStr, DATE_FORMAT(ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.MDATE ,'%Y-%m-%d') mdateStr, ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.VDATE vDate, ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.MDATE mDate, ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.CONTRACT_NO contractNo, ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.CONTRACT_RESULT contractResult, ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.SEC_ACCT_ID repFinancier, ETR_ENTRUST.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, ETR_DISTRIBUTE.TRADER trader, ETR_ENTRUST.COUNTER_ID counterId, ETR_ENTRUST.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, ETR_ENTRUST.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo , ETR_ENTRUST.REMARK remark from ETR_ENTRUST inner join ETR_ENTRUST_ADD on ETR_ENTRUST_ADD.ENTRUST_ID = ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID left join ETR_DISTRIBUTE on ETR_DISTRIBUTE.ENTRUST_ID = ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID where ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_ID =#{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
